_provenance.upstream_operation: sigVer (dedicated SigVer vectors with upstream testPassed + reason)
_provenance.local_operation: SigVer via PKCS#11 C_VerifyInit/C_Verify (CKM_ML_DSA; vendor CKM_ML_DSA_EXTERNAL_MU for externalMu groups)
_provenance.transformation: subset only; every retained field is byte-copied from the upstream file (hex case preserved); no value is re-derived
_provenance.subset_policy: Deterministic. external/pure groups: the positive case plus one case per upstream negative reason (modified message, modified signature - commitment/hint/z), each chosen as the shortest message in its (group, reason), ties broken by lowest tcId. internal/externalMu=true groups: one positive and one negative, each the lowest tcId (mu is always 64 bytes). external/preHash groups: not byte-copied (HashML-DSA positive coverage comes from mldsa_extended_test.json and mldsa_siggen_det_test.json); only the cases whose hashAlg has no PKCS#11 v3.2 CKM_HASH_ML_DSA_<hash> mechanism (SHA2-512/224, SHA2-512/256) are listed in notExecuted as metadata. internal/externalMu=false groups (ML-DSA.Verify_internal on a raw M-prime) are listed in notExecuted: no PKCS#11 v3.2 mechanism exposes that interface.
_provenance.retained_fields: tcId, testPassed, reason, hashAlg, pk, message|mu, context, signature (sk and deferred dropped)
_provenance.negative_classes_not_upstream: modified public key and modified context are NOT provided by this upstream file; the Hub derives them at run time from each parameter set's positive external/pure case and labels them product-authored (see localMutations) — they are never reported as NIST vectors
